sheetLayout: 4 columns by 8 rows: neutral indices 0-15, smile indices 16-31. Initial separate 4x4 sheets rejected for alpha speckles. Final combined repair preserves the same pose order in both families. mouth_v2_validation.json has exact crop bounds and anchors for all 32 poses.
registration: constant scale, horizontal center and upper mouth line; all cels need atlas-bound review
audit: Current sheets are clean enough to display, but FV, S, MBP and rest are not clearly differentiated.
AA has a dome-like silhouette while lower jaw opening reads better when its top edge remains stable.
Rest, full smile and some speech widths vary enough to look like a change of face.
A timed mouth selector should use speech timestamps rather than run the whole sheet as a loop. Extra frames alone do not create voice sync.
